directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: What's that mess you got into with Duty?
entries.JA_current: What's that mess you got into with Duty?
entries.JA_new: デューティーと何を揉めたんだ？

entries.EN: Help me, lad. Waste that faggot calling himself Bullet! He's getting on my nerves! The "family" will be grateful to you, for sure, we don't forget a good favor! Whack that schmuck and I'll hand over a location of a Duty stash. One that apparently belongs to the legendary Skull - a top honcho over there, I tell you. I'll stay here and wait for you.
entries.JA_current: Help me, lad. Waste that faggot calling himself Bullet! He's getting on my nerves! The "family" will be grateful to you, for sure, we don't forget a good favor! Whack that schmuck and I'll hand over a location of a Duty stash. One that apparently belongs to the legendary Skull - a top honcho over there, I tell you. I'll stay here and wait for you.
entries.JA_new: なあ、助けてくれよ。ブレットを名乗るクソ野郎を始末してくれ！もう我慢ならねえんだ！「身内」の連中も喜ぶぞ。受けた恩は忘れないからな！あいつを片づけたら、デューティーの隠し場所を教えてやる。あの有名なスカルの物らしい。あっちの大物だよ。俺はここで待ってる。

entries.EN: Sure thing, I'll help with... eh... "the matter". But - no bullshit, bud, make sure you don't disappear!
entries.JA_current: Sure thing, I'll help with... eh... "the matter". But - no bullshit, bud, make sure you don't disappear!
entries.JA_new: ああ、手伝うよ……その「件」な。だが、逃げるんじゃねえぞ。ちゃんとそこにいろ！
冗談じゃない。ふざけんな……

entries.EN: Ok, dude, but when our guys get you, they gonna make ya eat your own liver!
entries.JA_current: Ok, dude, but when our guys get you, they gonna make ya eat your own liver!
entries.JA_new: いいだろう。だがウチの連中に見つかったら、自分の肝臓を食わされるぞ！

entries.EN: See those blind dogs making the rounds over there, huh? If you keep chewing me out, I'll make them chew YOU out, scum. Farewell...
entries.JA_current: See those blind dogs making the rounds over there, huh? If you keep chewing me out, I'll make them chew YOU out, scum. Farewell...
entries.JA_new: あそこをうろついてるブラインドドッグが見えるか？まだ口答えするなら、今度はあいつらにお前を食わせてやるよ、クズ。じゃあな……
